decisions.reason: After four years without visible evidence of strong traction, this core-adjacent plugin faces a higher aspiration threshold, but its close fit and likely low support cost still make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.

The ERP interface most clearly supports the firm's end-to-end shop and multichannel positioning, so unless its results are plainly below aspiration management would more likely retain it or embed it in projects than discontinue it.

Because two comparable price-comparison plugins were already withdrawn and this category is less distinctive for the firm's current direction, management would likely redeploy resources if this remaining variant is not clearly outperforming aspiration.

The reporting plugin is related to the firm's analytics capabilities, but after several years and no later visibility it is more exposed to being absorbed into custom services or dropped if standalone demand remains below aspiration.
